# Named Routes

> Type-safe routes, URLs and public assets for seven frameworks. Documentation version 2.2.0.

Read the agent contract first. Always check the installed version and generated route names. Named Routes builds URLs; it does not replace framework routers or perform HTTP requests.

## Essential context

- [Agent contract](llms/agent-contract.md): conventions, imports, base paths, framework integration, API boundaries and safety.
- [Full English reference](llms-full.txt): complete offline-readable guide including examples.

## Documentation by subject

- [Nuxt](llms/en/groups/framework-nuxt.md): Nuxt: setup, File conventions & discovery, Links & navigation, Navigation — navigateTo(), Base path & deployment, Public assets, Localized links, HTTP endpoints
- [Vue Router](llms/en/groups/framework-vue.md): Vue Router: setup, File conventions & discovery, Links & navigation, Navigation — router.push(), Base path & deployment, Public assets, Localized links, HTTP boundaries
- [SvelteKit](llms/en/groups/framework-sveltekit.md): SvelteKit: setup, File conventions & discovery, Links & navigation, Navigation — goto(), Base path & deployment, Public assets, Localized links, HTTP endpoints

- [TanStack Router](llms/en/groups/framework-tanstack-router.md): TanStack Router: setup, File conventions & discovery, Links & navigation, Navigation — window.location.assign(), Base path & deployment, Public assets, Localized links, HTTP boundaries
